import os
import tempfile
import unittest

from task_api import TaskAPI


class Independent(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.path = os.path.join(self.temp.name, "qa.db")
        self.app = TaskAPI(self.path)

    def test_journey(self):
        status, task = self.app.request("POST", "/tasks", {"title": "QA journey"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.app.request("PATCH", f"/tasks/{task['id']}", {"completed": True})[0],
            200,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            TaskAPI(self.path).request("GET", "/tasks", {})[1][0]["completed"], 1
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.app.request("POST", "/tasks", {"title": " "})[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.app.request("DELETE", f"/tasks/{task['id']}", {})[0], 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.app.request("GET", "/tasks", {})[1], [])

    def test_unknown_fields(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            self.app.request("POST", "/tasks", {"title": "Valid", "unknown": True})[0],
            400,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.app.request("GET", "/tasks", {})[1], [])
